# AI Found Score

> Free report for local service businesses. We ask the AI assistants customers use the questions a customer in the business's town would ask (three questions in the free snapshot, through each assistant's official or commercial service with web search on) and show who got named and who got named first, plus one answer word for word. The paid audit shows every answer word for word and which websites the AI cited. Each report lists exactly which assistants were asked and when.

- The free report (AI Visibility Snapshot) costs nothing and uses public data only. No logins are required.
- AI Visibility Audit ($49, one-time): all 7 customer questions (including 2 for businesses your size) asked fresh on every assistant we check (each report lists which ones), every answer word for word and every website AI cited, exactly what's wrong on the business's website and Google listing, every fix with copy-paste text, a Fix Kit of ready-to-install files, a competitor gap sheet, a fix checklist, and a free re-scan 30 days later. Usually ready within the hour. Fewer than 3 problems specific to the business: the $49 back. Add-on at checkout, $25: the Competitor Breakdown, a scorecard of what the top 3 businesses AI names instead have that you don't, with a do-these-first list.
- AI Found Score can't promise what AI will say, and does not promise placement or bookings.
- Operator: Fields Holding d/b/a GetAiFound Score, 120 Terminal Drive, Plainview, NY 11803. Email: hello@aifoundscore.com
